source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The customer is asking whether we can also create a power point template?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
It will be from scratch.
They Will provide the design.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For the Power Point template, please share your thoughts on the customer's attached design.
Afterward, provide an estimate for creating the template.

These are my initial questions and comments::::::

[CLIENT_NAME_001]:

It is structured well.
The font sizes are precisely what they should be.

Below are my initial thoughts and feedback. Later, I will examine it more closely from a technical perspective.
Naturally, I will also provide an estimate.

Questions
The font sizes shown after the slash (55/65) indicate line height, correct?

Should the front page, section dividers, or paragraph slides not have a 16:9 background image with text placed over it?

The logo is generally not shown on every individual slide—is that the preference in this case?

The placeholder images in the splash are intended to work as a mask, correct?

The distance between the heading and body copy differs on slides 13 and 14. Was that done intentionally?

To Be Investigated
I need to consider slides 2 and 11 more carefully. If users need to add multiple bullets on their own, it may not be possible to have a bullet point containing highlighted text with body text below it. It might work if the number is restricted to only two, but I assume that is not what you want.

Design Questions
In numerous places, the text has been designed to fit the grid perfectly.
However, the appearance will naturally change if a user inserts one bullet point rather than two.
If more than two bullets are inserted, the text will become smaller to create enough space.

This is where practical, real-world use becomes relevant.
We should monitor it and see how it works in practice.

Please Send
Could you send me these graphic elements as vectors?

The bullet point

The shapes used for the selected splashes
